stats.text: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: {ref:equipment/chest}, Fine Clothes, {ref:equipment/ink}, 5 Ink Pens, {ref:equipment/lamp}, 2 Map or Scroll Cases, 4 flasks of {ref:equipment/oil}, 5 sheets of {ref:equipment/paper}, 5 sheets of {ref:equipment/parchment}, {ref:equipment/perfume}, and {ref:equipment/tinderbox}.
